newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Nine killed in Mogadishu faction fighting.
newsitem.headline: Nine killed in Mogadishu faction fighting.

text.p: At least nine people were killed in fighting on Friday between forces loyal to two Mogadishu faction leaders and self-styled president Hussein Aideed's militiamen, witnesses said.
They said the nine people were killed and more than 15 were wounded in more than an hour of street battles for the base of Hosh held by Aideed's forces in the northern suburbs of Medina district.
The dead included three displaced Somalis killed when a stray mortar bomb exploded inside their camp, witnesses said.

It was believed to be the first time since the death of south Mogadishu faction leader Mohamed Farah Aideed in August that forces loyal to Ali Mahdi Mohamed, who also claims the presidency, and Osman Hassan Ali Atto fought alongside each other against Hussein Aideed's militiamen.
Hussein Aideed, a 34-year-old former U.S. marine, succeeded his father and was elected president of Somalia by supporters. But he and his government are rejected by many other faction leaders.
